claims.claim_ar: من الممكن أن تكون «فِيهَا» ظرفًا متعلِّقًا بالفعل «حَسُنَتْ» (أي ظرف مكان يرفع الخبر أو يتعلَّق بالفعل).
claims.claim_en: ‘fīhā’ can function as a circumstantial adverb (ẓarf) of place attached to the verb ‘ḥasunat’ (i.e., a place-adverb governing/affecting the predicate).
claims.needs_review_reason: The source gives a general rule that a ظرف can affect/raise a predicate; it does not explicitly analyze this ayah, so the attachment to حَسُنَتْ is an inference needing confirmation.

claims.claim_ar: «مُسْتَقَرَّاً» قد تكون حالًا منصوبة تتعلق بالفعل «حَسُنَتْ».
claims.claim_en: ‘mustaqarran’ may be a ḥāl (circumstantial accusative) in the accusative, modifying the verb ‘ḥasunat’.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited passage discusses items occurring in the position of ḥāl; it is a general support for analyzing an accusative as حال, not an explicit parsing of this word in this verse.

claims.source_quote_ar: فِي مَوْضِعِ نَصْبٍ عَلَى تَقْدِيرِ أَعْنِي.
claims.claim_ar: «مُقَامًا» قد تكون منصوبة على تقدير اسم محذوف (مثلاً تقدير «مَقَامًا/مَكانًا») لتكون تمييزًا أو حالًا متعلقًا بـ«حَسُنَتْ».
claims.claim_en: ‘muqāman’ may be accusative by تقدير (i.e., with an omitted noun such as ‘maqām’/‘makān’ understood), functioning as a tamyīz (specification) or ḥāl related to ‘ḥasunat’.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source states that words can occur in a position of accusative on a تقدير; applying this to مُقَامًا in this verse is an interpretive step and should be checked against explicit commentary on the verse.
